title: Dad in the family's toy style
kaylee: Dad looks like he belongs with Kaylee and Mom now: same cupped ears, twisted horn, curled tail and hoof socks, a smooth swept mane, no white patch round his mouth. Same eyes, same yellow shirt.
questions: Keep his blue and lavender mane, or brown like Kaylee and Mom?
